_style: Top-down overhead photo, camera pointing straight down at a plain light wooden table, soft even daylight, sharp focus, realistic, 16:9 landscape. No text, no people visible.
_motion: Fixed overhead camera that never moves, zooms or cuts. The only person visible is ONE person's RIGHT hand, always the same right hand and never the left: medium-light skin tone, slender fingers, short clean unpolished nails, no rings, no watch, no bracelet, no tattoos, with a plain solid dark gray long sleeve ending at the wrist. It enters from the bottom edge of the frame, picks up the object at a natural, brisk pace and finishes placing it within about 7 seconds, sets it down in its final position, then leaves the frame completely before the 10 seconds are over. Every other object stays exactly where it is and nothing appears, disappears or changes. No text, no music. Each object is set down gently and upright, exactly in the stated spot, and then never moves again: the hand never touches, nudges or covers objects that are already placed.

steps.edit: Move the red mug into the gray dish drying tray, in its left slot. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the red mug and puts it upright in the gray tray at the left end of the tray's top row, handle pointing right.

steps.edit: Move the blue mug into the gray dish drying tray, next to the red mug. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the blue mug and puts it upright in the tray in the middle of the top row, handle pointing right, a small gap from the red mug.

steps.edit: Move the green mug into the gray dish drying tray, next to the other two mugs. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the green mug and puts it upright in the tray at the right end of the top row, handle pointing right, a small gap from the blue mug.

fruit_into_bowl.scene: A red apple, an orange and a yellow lemon sit spread apart on the left half of the table. A white ceramic bowl sits on the right half of the table, empty.

steps.edit: Move the red apple into the white bowl. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the red apple and puts it in the white bowl on the left side of the bowl.

steps.edit: Move the orange into the white bowl next to the apple. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the orange and puts it in the bowl on the right side of the bowl, next to the apple.

steps.edit: Move the yellow lemon into the white bowl. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the yellow lemon and puts it in the bowl at the top of the bowl, between and above the apple and the orange.

toys_into_bin.scene: A red wooden toy block, a green wooden toy block and a blue wooden toy block sit spread apart on the left half of the table. An open brown cardboard box, seen from above, sits on the right half of the table, empty.

steps.edit: Move the red block into the cardboard box. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the red block and puts it flat inside the cardboard box in the top-left corner of the box's floor.

steps.edit: Move the green block into the cardboard box. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the green block and puts it flat inside the box in the top-right corner of the box's floor, a small gap from the red block.

steps.edit: Move the blue block into the cardboard box. Keep everything else exactly the same.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the blue block and puts it flat inside the box in the bottom-left corner of the box's floor, a small gap from the red block.

dishes_wash.scene: A white ceramic plate with brown food stains on it lies on the left half of the table, and a blue plate with brown food stains lies on the right half. A yellow kitchen sponge sits on the bottom middle of the table. Nothing else is on the table.

steps.motion: The hand picks up the yellow sponge and scrubs the white plate with firm back-and-forth strokes until all the brown stains are gone and the plate is clean, then puts the sponge down where it was at the bottom middle of the table.

The hand picks up the yellow sponge and scrubs the blue plate with firm back-and-forth strokes until all the brown stains are gone and the plate is clean, then puts the sponge down where it was at the bottom middle of the table.

book_push_aside.scene: A large flat green book lies flat in the center of the table. A small red block sits behind it.

steps.edit: Push the green book behind the red block without lifting it.
steps.motion: The hand pushes the green book across the table without ever lifting it, until it rests behind the red block, then leaves the frame.

lamp_press.scene: An orange push light sits in the center of the table.

steps.edit: Press the orange push light so it clicks on.
steps.motion: The hand presses it straight down once with two fingertips, the light clicks on, and the hand leaves.

cooking_prep.scene: A white dough bar and a gray kitchen knife lie side by side on the upper left of the table. A red cup full of dry cereal sits on the lower left. A white bowl filled with white flour sits on the right half of the table. A yellow spoon lies on the bottom middle of the table. Nothing else is on the table.

steps.edit: Cut the dough bar in two.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the gray knife, draws it straight across the middle of the white dough bar cutting it into two pieces, then lays the knife down beside the halves.

steps.edit: Pour the cereal into the bowl.
steps.motion: The hand picks up the red cup, holds it over the white bowl, tips it and pours all the cereal into the flour, then sets the empty cup down on the lower left of the table.
The hand picks up the yellow spoon, stirs it round and round through the bowl several times, then lays the spoon across the bowl.
